messages.content: Approval came through. Before you reserve the St. Louis room, compare the host hotel with the cheaper property by Cortex using the full trip cost, not just the room rate.

The host AC Hotel is $188.42 for Monday night, including tax, breakfast, and a $22 destination charge. It is guaranteed by card but not charged until the stay, with free cancellation through 6:00 p.m. Central on May 3. The Cortex-area property is $158.60 including tax, charged in full now and nonrefundable. Estimated rides are $97 with the AC versus $123 from the Cortex property because it adds two transfers. Including the $286 flights and $20 transportation cushion, the totals are $591.42 and $587.60, respectively.
So the prepaid option only saves $3.82 overall?
Correct. Its $29.82 room savings are almost entirely offset by $26 in additional rides. Both plans remain below the $850 allowance, before meals and Dallas-side transportation.
Confirm the movement between the airport, hotel, and both meeting locations. Also check whether I can leave my suitcase Tuesday.

From STL, allow about 20 to 25 minutes by car to the AC. Monday's funder session is at the host hotel, so no transfer is needed after check-in. Tuesday morning, Cortex is about 1.5 miles away, generally a 5 to 10 minute ride. You would return to the AC for the suitcase, then continue to the closing program; from there, allow roughly 25 minutes to STL after 6:00 p.m. The AC confirmed complimentary storage before check-in and after checkout on Tuesday. The Cortex property also confirmed Tuesday storage, but its location still creates the two extra rides.
Is the destination charge definitely already in the AC total, and are there any payment surprises?

Yes. The displayed $188.42 total includes the room, taxes, and mandatory destination charge. Breakfast is included. The card secures the reservation, the stay is payable at the hotel, and a temporary incidentals authorization may be placed at check-in. Canceling after 6:00 p.m. Central on May 3 triggers a one-night room-and-tax charge.
Reserve the AC. Keep the existing Southwest flights and transfer allowance.

The AC Hotel St. Louis Central West End is reserved for May 5 for one night at $188.42 total. Payment is due at the property, and free cancellation runs through 6:00 p.m. Central on May 3. Breakfast and Tuesday luggage storage are confirmed, and the mandatory destination charge is included. With the selected Southwest flights, $97 in estimated rides, and the $20 cushion, the trip remains estimated at $591.42, leaving $258.58 of the approval unused.
